## Progress

- Merged [PR #3](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/3): docker-compose with SQL Server 2022 (healthcheck, runs under Rosetta on Apple silicon), Azurite, smtp4dev; `pnpm services:up`
- Left: one-command start that migrates + seeds (needs MDV-P0-027), dev-only OIDC stub (MDV-P0-011), SMS sink (MDV-P1-033)

## Description

docker-compose.yml with SQL Server 2022 (Developer), Azurite (Blob), smtp4dev (email sink) and a fake SMS endpoint, plus a one-command start (`make dev` or `pnpm dev`) that applies EF Core migrations and seeds the synthetic tenant. Local identity uses a development Entra External ID tenant or a dev-only OIDC stub that is impossible to enable outside Development.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given Docker is running, when I run the documented start command, then API, web/clinic and all dependencies start and the seeded synthetic tenant can sign in within 5 minutes on a clean machine.
- [ ] **AC2.** The dev OIDC stub refuses to start unless ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development (verified by a test).
- [ ] **AC3.** No real secrets are needed locally; .env.example lists variable names only.
- [ ] **AC4.** Emails and SMS sent locally appear in the sinks and are never delivered externally.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
